RAGFlow Test Document

This is a sample document used for testing the RAGFlow document processing pipeline.

Section 1: Introduction

RAGFlow is an open-source RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) engine based on deep document understanding. It provides a streamlined RAG workflow for businesses of any scale, combining LLM (Large Language Models) to provide truthful question-answering capabilities.

Section 2: Key Features

- Deep document understanding: RAGFlow chunks documents based on deep layout understanding, not just simple text splitting
- Template-based chunking: Different templates for various document types like QA, papers, manuals, etc.
- Reduced hallucination: Grounded citations with visualized text chunking
- Compatibility: Works with various heterogeneous data sources

Section 3: Architecture

The RAGFlow architecture consists of several key components:
1. Document Processing Pipeline
2. Vector Store Integration
3. LLM Integration Layer
4. API Server
5. Web Frontend

Section 4: Testing Information

This document contains test content that should be chunked into multiple sections. The chunking algorithm should:
- Respect section boundaries
- Maintain semantic coherence
- Handle different text lengths appropriately

Table of Important Values:
| Parameter | Value | Description |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| chunk_size | 128 | Default chunk token size |
| overlap | 0.1 | Overlap percentage |
| min_tokens | 10 | Minimum tokens per chunk |

Section 5: Conclusion

This sample document demonstrates various text structures that the parsing and chunking systems need to handle correctly during testing.

End of Document
